MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_SWEEP.title: Charged Sweep
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_ECHO.title: Charged Backlash
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_ECHO.descriptio: When [color=33ccff][b]【Witchification】[/b][/color] increases, deal an equal amount of ability-affected [color=#33ccff]damage[/color] to a random target
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_TRANSFER.title: Charged Transfer
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_TRANSFER.descri:
Choose 1 [color=33ccff][b]【Witchification】[/b][/color] card,
transfer its counter to another
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_BURST.title: Charged Release
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_BURST.descripti:
Set the counters of all [color=33ccff][b]【Witchification】[/b][/color] cards in hand to 0,
gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each point set to 0
Clear your [b]Strength[/b] down; choose a target to gain [b]【Suspicion】[/b] equal to half your current [b]【Suspicion】[/b] and an equal amount of [b]Strength[/b].
If 3 stacks are gained, the [green]target[/green] and you each gain a stack of [green]【Tono Hanna's Magic】[/green]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_TRANSFER.title: Suspicion Transfer
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_TRANSFER.descr: All allies lose 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b]; transfer the same amount of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] to any enemy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_STRENGTH.title: Power of Suspicion
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_STRENGTH.descr: Make a random teammate gain 1 [b]Strength[/b], a number of times equal to the total [b]【Suspicion】[/b] stacks of all allies
ManosabaLin.RetainCounterComponent.hover: Gains Retain; at the [color=33ccff]start of each turn[/color] its counter +1, then the card's values are multiplied by the counter
ManosabaLin.RemoveOnPlayComponent.hovert: After being played, permanently remove this card from combat
MANOSABA_LIN_MODEL_CAPABILITY_REMOVE_ON_: After being played, this card is permanently removed from combat
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYMONVQIUFAN.title: Witch Prisoner
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BANYANFA.title: Method Acting
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BANYANFA.description:
If [color=#33ccff][b]【Witchification】[/b][/color] in your [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color]
is more than half,
gain one [green]【Helplessness】[/green],
otherwise gain one [color=#33ccff]【Curiosity】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMAXIELI.title: Ema's Assistance
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMAXIELI.description: At [color=33ccff]start of turn[/color] give all enemies 10 stacks of [color=#ff99cc]【Witch Factor】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DESTROY_EVERYTHING.des:
[color=#cccccc]Lose this card's recorded resources[/color]
Deal 13 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color], immediately [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color],
deal [color=#33ccff]damage[/color] equal to 5× [b]【Suspicion】[/b] to all enemies; for each [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] card lost (up to 4) deal 8 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]
Randomly remove 1 card each from [color=#33ccff]draw, discard, and hand[/color]; for each removed, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 1 [color=#33ccff]card[/color]
For each [color=#33ccff][b]【Witchification】[/b][/color] counter lost, generate 1 card that costs 1 less.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_FIST.title: Left Hand Great Strength, Right Hand Strength Great
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_FIST.description:
At [color=33ccff]start of turn[/color]
randomly gain 【Left Fist】 or 【Right Fist】
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMPTY_HOUSE.title: The Empty House
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMPTY_HOUSE.descriptio:
At the start of your turn, mark 1 card in the [color=#33ccff]exhaust pile[/color]
When played, deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]; for each marked card deal 1 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color], and add the marked cards to your hand.
If you triggered [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color] this [color=33ccff]turn[/color],
these cards can be played for free once [color=33ccff]this turn[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FINAL_FAREWELL.title: Final Farewell
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_LAST_CASE.title: The Last Case
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_LAST_CASE.description:
Choose 1 [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] card to Retain,
[color=#33ccff]remove[/color] all other [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] cards.
Deal 13 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]; deal 4 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color] for each [color=#33ccff]removed[/color].
If you triggered [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color], each instead deals {IfUpgraded:show:10 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]|8 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]} and you gain half of the [color=#33ccff]removed[/color] [rainbow][b]【Basic Emotion】[/b][/rainbow].
If more than 8 are [color=#33ccff]removed[/color], immediately [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color],
gain [color=#33ccff]Curiosity[/color] or [green]Helplessness[/green], and gain {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} stacks of [rainbow][b]【Complex Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SACRIFICE_TANK.title: Ill-Fated Lovers
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SACRIFICE_TANK.descrip:
Take double [color=#33ccff]damage[/color] from enemies. Enemy damage towards allies is [green]halved[/green]
For every 20 total attack [color=#33ccff]damage[/color] taken, you gain 1 stack of [color=33ccff]next-turn[/color] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, and each other teammate gains 1 stack of [green]next-turn draw[/green] and 10 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]
ManosabaLin.EMPTY_HOUSE_COMPONENT.hovert: Marked by 【The Empty House】. Added to your hand when 【The Empty House】 is played.
ManosabaLin.Sherryyuanzui.hovertip.title: The Destroyer Detective
ManosabaLin.Sherryyuanzui.hovertip.descr:
[color=#33ccff][jitter]She destroyed everything.
Not just cases, not just people, but even her own heart[/jitter][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_PERIODIC_FUSION.title: The Great Investigation
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_PERIODIC_FUSION.descri:
[color=33ccff]Every {Interval:diff()} turns[/color] gain 1 stack of
[rainbow][b]【Complex Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] and gain 1 random [rainbow][b]【Basic Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EXHAUST_FIST.title: [The Black Hole]'s Magic
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EXHAUST_FIST.descripti:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]
For each card exhausted this combat, this card deals 3 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYBADENDING.title: 【Bad Ending】
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYBADENDING.descri:
[color=#33ccff][jitter]「At the end of the sea of flowers, the souls of the living shall warm your fingertips; after the embrace comes the eternal parting」[/jitter][/color]
[b]When this card is discarded it returns to hand; when it is [b]exhausted[/b] it returns to hand[/b]
At [color=#33ccff]start of turn[/color] gain 3 stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b]; during [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color] you cannot gain [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] and half of all cards are removed
At [color=#33ccff]end of turn[/color], [color=#33ccff]【Witchification】[/color] counters in hand -1 and remove 2 [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] cards
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYDEATH.title: 「At the end of the sea of flowers, the souls of the living shall warm your fingertips; after the embrace comes the eternal parting」
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYDEATH.descriptio: The ending of the individual known as [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry】[/color]
ManosabaLin.SherryDeath.hovertip.title: Witch Execution
ManosabaLin.SherryDeath.hovertip.descrip:
[b]This card returns to your hand at the [color=33ccff]start of turn[/color][/b]
Play [color=#cccccc]Death[/color],
give all teammates half of the [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] of all cards
If [b]【Others' Emotions】[/b] card count is greater than 2, add 1 random [rainbow][b]【Basic Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] to a teammate's [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color]; greater than 4 gives [rainbow][b]【Complex Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]; greater than 20 gives [color=#33ccff][b]「Friend[/b][/color][green][b]ship」[/b][/green]
[b]Exhaust[/b] 50 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b] and 3 stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] from all teammates
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GEINILUNHUI.title: Geini Reincarnation
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GEINILUNHUI.descriptio:
Choose 1 card from [color=#CC6666]all cards[/color] and automatically choose up to 2 cards with the same name to lose [color=#CC6666]【Transmigration】[/color],
the target ally chooses 1 card in their [color=#CC6666]draw pile[/color] to gain [color=#CC6666]【Transmigration】[/color] and copies up to 2
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHARED_WITCH_RITUAL.de:
If both you and the target have
100 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b], then
you and the target gain 1 stack of [b]【Witch Ritual】[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHARED_EXHAUST_PLAY.de:
Exhaust 2 cards from another ally's [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color] or [color=#33ccff]discard pile[/color],
then have each ally play the exhausted cards once
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TEAM_ZERO_GIFT.title: Zero-Energy Gift
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THREE_CARD_OMEN.title: Omen
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THREE_CARD_OMEN.descri:
Choose 1 ally; when they play 3 [color=#33ccff]consecutive[/color] cards of the [color=#33ccff]same type[/color] this turn, they gain the corresponding ability
Only once
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ENCHANTMENT_CONVERGENC:
Choose an ally. Each turn, when any of your [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Jud[/color][color=#6699cc]gment[/color][color=#339966]】[/color] enchantment counters reach 5, it is anchored;
afterwards, the extra effects of that enchantment counter are also gained by the chosen ally
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BOND_VERDICT.title: Will You Be My Friend?
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_COVENANT.title: Hiro, Don't Die
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_COVENANT.descr:
[b]Exhaust[/b] all of the [color=#CC6666]target ally's[/color] [b]Suspicion[/b]; [color=#ff99cc]you[/color] gain the same amount of [b]Suspicion[/b].
If [color=#ff99cc]you[/color] have 11 stacks of [b]Suspicion[/b], [color=#ff99cc]you[/color] and the [color=#CC6666]target ally[/color] gain 1 stack of [b]【Witch Ritual】[/b]{IfUpgraded:show: and split the [b]Suspicion[/b] equally between [color=#ff99cc]you[/color] and the [color=#CC6666]target ally[/color]|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_JUSTICE_RELAY.title: Justice That Converges
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_JUSTICE_RELAY.descript: [color=#CC6666]This turn[/color], whenever an ally draws 1 [color=#CC6666]card[/color] and restores {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, give them 1 stack of [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_ATTACK.title: Strike
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_DEFEND.title: Defend
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_WITCH_PRISONER:
[color=6666cc]This turn[/color], gain {TempStrength:diff()} [b]Strength[/b],
{TempDexterity:diff()} [b]Dexterity[/b],
set the number of times enemies whose [color=6666cc]intent[/color] was [color=6666cc]edited[/color] to 0
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_ONE.title: Guilt Gnawing at the Bones
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_ONE.descriptio:
Give the target enemy {SuspectPower:diff()} stacks of
[b]【Suspicion】[/b] and [b]Weak[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_TWO.title: Prelude to Guilt
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_THREE.title: Reversing Witch Taint
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_THREE.descript:
Reduce {Reduction:diff()} stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b] from 1 ally target;
you and the target each draw {Draw:diff()} [color=#6666cc]cards[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_SEVEN.title: Accomplice
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_SEVEN.descript: Give an ally 3 cards of {IfUpgraded:show:Prelude to Guilt+|Prelude to Guilt}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_EIGHT.title: Acquittal
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_CARD_TEN.title: Nikaido Hiro
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_CARD_TEN.descr:
Gain {SuspectPower} stacks of Suspicion. Gain 1 stack of [color=#CC6666]【Nikaido Hiro's Magic】[/color]
[color=#6666cc]Remove all cards with the same name from your deck[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_MLLM.title: Kamiya Meruru
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_MLLM.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] to an ally target,
gain 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b], give {MllmPower:diff()} stacks of
[color=#ffcc99]【Meruru on Ice's Magic】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_MGM.title: Takarada Mag
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_MGM.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color],
gain {SuspectPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] and {MgmPower:diff()} stacks of
[purple]【Takarada Mag's Magic】[/purple]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_LYM.title: Hasumi Reiya
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_LYM.descriptio:
Gain 4 stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b],
give the target
[gold]【Hasumi Reia's Magic】[/gold]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_NYXM.title: Kurobe Naeka
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_NYXM.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color], gain 1 stack of
[color=#999999]【Kurobe Nao's Magic】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_KKM.title: Sawado Koko
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_KKM.descriptio:
Choose 1 ally, deal 1 [color=#6666cc]damage[/color], and grant them {KkmPower:diff()} stacks of
[color=#ff9966]【Sawada Koko's Magic】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_NYM.title: Kinoshita Noah
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_NYM.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color],
gain 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] and 10 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b], give the target 2 stacks of
[blue]【Noah Kinoshita's Magic】[/blue]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_AMM.title: Sakuraba Ema
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_AMM.descriptio:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color]
(base {CalculationBase:diff()} + 【Suspicion】{SuspectBonus:diff()} + 【Witchification】{WitchificationBonus:diff()}). Gain {SuspectPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] and {WithPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b], {AmmPower:diff()} stacks of
[color=#ff99cc]【Sakuraba Emma's Magic】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_AAM.title: Natsume Anan
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_AAM.descriptio:
Reduce {AnanlinBrainwashBacklashPower:diff()} stacks of your [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash Backlash】[/color].
This effect can only take effect once per combat.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_MLYM.title: Saeki Milia
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_MLYM.descripti: Choose 1 teammate and give them [color=#cc9966]【Saeki Milia's Magic】[/color], swap your hands, then enchant those cards with [color=#cc9966]【Magic's Aftereffect】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_SUSPECT_SPREAD:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color],
+1 [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] for each stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] you have
Apply 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] to the target and yourself
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_GUILTY_CHAIN.d:
[color=6666cc]Each turn[/color], when you play a card against an enemy with [b]【Suspicion】[/b], randomly apply 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] to another enemy;
triggers up to 2 times [color=6666cc]each turn[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_POWERTWOTWOCAR: Usable at 100 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]. Gain {RitualCeremonyPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Witch Ritual】[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_POWERFOURFOURC: At [color=6666cc]start of turn[/color], gain 40 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_FRIEND.title: Friend
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_FRIEND.descrip:
Gain 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b]; choose
1 [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry】{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/color]
or [green]【Tono Hanna】{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/green]
to add to your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_TWELVE.title: Fuji Alisa
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_TWELVE.descrip:
Reduce {ConsumeAmount:diff()} stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] from 1 ally;
gain {IfUpgraded:show:{energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)}|{energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}},
gain {SuspectPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] for yourself, and 1 stack of
[color=#ff0000]【Fuji Alisa's Magic】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BLANK_PAGE.title: Blank Page
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BLANK_PAGE.description:
Randomly gain 1 {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}card from a recorded card pool
If 3 pools are recorded, choose one of three instead
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MARGIN_PAGE.title: Margin Page
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MARGIN_PAGE.descriptio:
List 3 options of different rarities from your currently recorded pools;
you may choose 1 {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}card to add to your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_SILENT_FORESHA:
Gain 5 [color=#6666cc]Block[/color],
{Silence:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color].
If you did not play an [b]Attack card[/b] this turn, draw {Cards:diff()} [color=#6666cc]cards[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_LOWER_VOICE.de:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color],
{Silence:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color].
If an enemy's [color=#6666cc]intent[/color] is to attack,
gain {AttackIntentBlock:diff()} additional [color=#6666cc]Block[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_RHETORICAL_QUE:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color].
If the target has [color=#6666cc]【Silenced】[/color], randomly trigger 1 kind of replacement intent.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_NO_ANSWER.desc:
At [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color],
if you did not play an [b]Attack card[/b] this [color=#6666cc]turn[/color], [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] replacement intent value +1.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_CLERK_HINT.des:
Gain {GainSilence:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] or
exhaust {SpendSilence:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color],
draw {Cards:diff()} [color=#6666cc]cards[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_JUDGMENT_EVE.d:
This combat, each time an enemy's [color=#6666cc]intent[/color] is rewritten, record 1.
At [color=#6666cc]start of turn[/color], if at least 3 are recorded, exhaust up to {AnanlinJudgmentEvePower:diff()} records: draw that many [color=#6666cc]cards[/color] and gain that much {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color].
If no enemy's [color=#6666cc]intent[/color] is to attack,
gain {Vigor:diff()} stacks of [b]Vigor[/b],
deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] {Hits:diff()} times
If the target has [color=#6666cc]【Silenced】[/color], attack 1 more time
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_LOW_VOICE_REPE:
Gain [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] equal to the number of [b]Skill cards[/b] played [color=#6666cc]this turn[/color] plus {BaseSilence:diff()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} [color=#6666cc]cards[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_TRACING.title: Tracing Copy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_TRACING.descri:
Generate 1 [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color].
The next time a [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] generates a card, copy the card it generates{IfUpgraded:show:; the copy can be played for free once [color=#6666cc]this turn[/color]|}.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_INDEX_PAGE.des: When [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] generates a card, {AnanlinIndexPagePower:diff()} additional options appear
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_THREE_COLOR_BO:
For each recorded card pool,
draw {Cards:diff()} [color=#6666cc]cards[/color] and gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color]
For each enemy whose intent is [b]Attack[/b],
you may choose 1 card from [color=#6666cc]all cards[/color] and turn it into 1 [color=#6666cc]【{IfUpgraded:show:Blank Page+|Blank Page}】[/color]
Choose a hand card from a recorded pool
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_BORROWING_PERI:
Each [color=#6666cc]turn[/color], after the {AnanlinBorrowingPeriodPower:diff()}th card from a recorded pool is played, it is instead [b]exhausted[/b],
and you draw 1 [color=#6666cc]card[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_COMPLETE_CHARA: If fewer than 3 card pools are recorded, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)} and remove this card from combat. Otherwise, generate 1 {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}card from a recorded card pool
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_SPECIFIED_GENR:
Choose [b]Attack[/b], [b]Skill[/b], or [b]Power[/b].
The next {BlankPages:diff()} [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] prioritize generating cards of that type
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_SPREAD_PROOFRE:
Choose 1 card in hand; generate 1 card from a recorded card pool of the same type but higher rarity,
and copy compatible additional effects{IfUpgraded:show:; the new card costs 1 less [color=#6666cc]this turn[/color]|}.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_TEMPORARY_BORR:
Gain 1 [color=#6666cc]【{IfUpgraded:show:Blank Page+|Blank Page}】[/color].
Generate 1 {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}card from a recorded card pool and Exhaust it; if it costs less than {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}, Exhaust it after it is played.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_MIRIAS_MOVIE_P:
Choose 1 card in hand and remove it from combat.
At [color=#6666cc]the start of next turn[/color], add a copy of it that can be played once for free to your hand.
Generate 1 card from the same card pool; it can be played once for free [color=#6666cc]this turn[/color] and gains [b]Exhaust[/b] and [b]Ethereal[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ANANLIN_PLAYWRIGHT_AND:
Choose 1 card from [color=#6666cc]all cards[/color] and rewrite it into 1 of 3 differently named cards of the same type you can currently play.
If the obtained card is from a recorded card pool, its cost becomes 0 this turn; otherwise it costs 1 less this turn.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_AAM.title: Natsume Anan

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_MLYM.title: Saeki Miria

Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color];
for each stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] you have, this card's [color=#ff0000]damage[/color] +1.

[b]【Suspicion】[/b] to both the target and yourself
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_GUILTY_CHAIN:
[color=#ff0000]Each turn[/color], when you play a card against an enemy with [b]【Suspicion】[/b], randomly apply 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b] to another enemy;

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_POWERTWOTWOC: Requires 100 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]. Gain {RitualCeremonyPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Witch Ritual】[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_POWERFOURFOU: At [color=#ff0000]start of turn[/color], gain 40 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_FRIEND.title: Friend
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_FRIEND.descr:
Gain 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b]; choose

or [green]【Tono Hanna】{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/green]

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_TWELVE.title: Fuji Alisa
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_TWELVE.descr:
Gain {SuspectPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Suspicion】[/b],
immediately trigger the end-of-turn effect of [color=#00ffff]【Ignite】[/color] once
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_TOWER.title: The Tower
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_TOWER.descri: [color=#ff0000][jitter]「I feel like... I've figured it out. I'll protect you all.」[/jitter][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALIN_TOWER_EFFECT:
Gain 100 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b] and
1 stack of [b]【Witch Ritual】[/b]; rebuild the enemy's Fire Color slots into 12 slots. When you play an Embers card you additionally link a card of another character, and gain Block equal to the total cost of all Embers cards among all your cards.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CONTRAST_WOUND.title: Contrast Wound
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CONTRAST_WOUND.descrip:
Deal {DamageAfter:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color]
({DamageBase:diff()} + twice this combat's [color=#00ffff]forgiveness[/color] count) [color=#ff0000]damage[/color].
If you hold an [b]Original Sin[/b] in hand, you may choose 1 to [color=#00ffff]forgive[/color] immediately (halve this [color=#ff0000]damage[/color])
If you hold none, you may choose to add 1 [b]Original Sin[/b] to your hand and [color=#00ffff]forgive[/color] it, then halve this [color=#ff0000]damage[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CONTRAST_WOUND.yesNoPr: Add 1 [b]Original Sin curse[/b] to your hand and [color=#00ffff]forgive[/color] it?
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_TRACK_DAY.title: Dual Track Day
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_TRACK_DAY.descrip:
After an [b]Original Sin[/b] triggers [color=#ff0000]Punish[/color],
you may immediately [color=#00ffff]forgive[/color] one [b]Original Sin[/b] among [color=#ff0000]all your cards[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FULL_COURT_VERDICT.des:
Choose any number of Original Sins among [color=#ff0000]all your cards[/color] to [color=#ff0000][b]Punish[/b][/color], and [color=#00ffff][b]Forgive[/b][/color] the rest.
If [color=#00ffff]Forgiven[/color] > [color=#ff0000]Punished[/color]: draw the difference,
if [color=#ff0000]Punished[/color] ≥ [color=#00ffff]Forgiven[/color]: gain energy equal to the difference and lose {HpMult:diff()}× that much HP.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FULL_COURT_VERDICT.sel: Choose [b]Original Sins[/b] to [color=#ff0000]Punish[/color] (the unselected ones will be [color=#00ffff]Forgiven[/color])
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_INDICTMENT.title: Indictment
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_INDICTMENT.description:
Choose 1 of 3 [b]Original Sins[/b] to add to your [color=#ff0000]draw pile[/color]{IfUpgraded:show:
gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color].|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_GIFT.title: Gift of Sin
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_GIFT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color]. Gain a random Original Sin curse with the Original Sin component.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_MARKET.title: Sin Market
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_MARKET.description:
Reveal all [b]Original Sins[/b] among [color=#ff0000]all your cards[/color], choose {SelectCount:diff()} cards; each randomly triggers one effect:
[color=#00ffff]Forgive[/color] immediately
return it to your hand
[color=#ff0000]Punish[/color] immediately
if there are not enough cards, you may choose to add [b]Original Sins[/b] to make up the count
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_MARKET.yesNoPrompt: Add 1 [b]Original Sin curse[/b] to your hand to make up the count?
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SIN_OFFERING.title: Sin Offering
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_REDEMPTION_CORRIDOR.de:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color].
Add 1 [b]Original Sin[/b] to your hand and [color=#00ffff]Forgive[/color] it.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZHI_MING_HUAN_YA.title: Remand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZHI_MING_HUAN_YA.yesNo: Add 1 [b]Original Sin curse[/b] to your [color=#ff0000]draw pile[/color]?
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_NI_NI_ZHI_ZHENG.title: Token of Contempt
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_NI_NI_ZHI_ZHENG.descri:
Each time you [color=#ff0000]Punish[/color] an [b]Original Sin[/b], gain 1 stack;
each stack grants 1 [b]Strength[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_KUAN_SHU_YIN_JI.title: Mark of Forgiveness
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_XING_JIA_JIA_SHEN.desc:
Each turn, after the first{IfUpgraded:show: 2|} [b]Original Sin[/b] card(s) are played,
reduce its cost by 1, add Exhaust, then add it to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_XUN_HUAN_FA_DIAN.title: Codex of Reincarnation
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_YE_SHENG_DUN.title: Shield of Sin
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_YE_SHENG_DUN.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color];
gain 1 additional [color=#6666cc]Block[/color] for each [color=#00ffff]Forgive[/color] or [color=#ff0000]Punish[/color] that has occurred this combat.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_JI_HEN_FAN_SHI.title: Backlash of Envy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_JI_HEN_FAN_SHI.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#6666cc]damage[/color],
gain 1 [b]Original Sin[/b].
If you [color=#ff0000]Punished[/color] this turn, double this [color=#6666cc]damage[/color];
if you [color=#00ffff]Forgave[/color] last turn, also gain [color=#6666cc]Block[/color] equal to it.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_ZHAI_DI_YA.title: Mortgaged Sin
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZUI_ZHAI_DI_YA.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color].
Then choose:
1) [color=#00ffff]Forgive[/color] 1 [b]Original Sin[/b] in hand, then Exhaust it.
2) [color=#ff0000]Punish[/color] 1 [b]Original Sin[/b] in hand, then Exhaust it.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_IGNITE.title: Ignite
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_IGNITE.description:
[b]Magic[/b]
[color=#ff0000][jitter]「Once my magic grows stronger, I'll burn to ashes everyone who drove us to this point」[/jitter][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNWANTEDKINDNESS.title: Unwanted Kindness
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNWANTEDKINDNESS.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color];
if a card was burned by [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] this time, gain 1 [b]Strength[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETURNEDHAIRRIBBON.tit: The Hair Ribbon I Return to You
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETURNEDHAIRRIBBON.des:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color],
deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color].
Recover 1 card from your [color=#ff0000]discard pile[/color] and give it [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETURNEDHAIRRIBBON.sel: Choose 1 card from the [color=#ff0000]discard pile[/color] to recover

Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color].
Choose 1 card in hand to gain [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color];
this card's [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] link to an Attack card in your [color=#ff0000]draw pile[/color]; if you choose an Attack card under the [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] effect,

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DAZZLINGTOLERANCE.desc:
When [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] burn a card, randomly deal 1 [color=#ff0000]damage[/color] and gain 2 [color=#ff0000]Block[/color];

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDAPOLOGY.title: Burning the Apology to Ash
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDAPOLOGY.descript: Embers gain: if the burned card can be played, auto-play it once for free, then burn it. Auto-played cards do not trigger Embers.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TWOSEPARATEDENDS.title: Two Separated Ends
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TWOSEPARATEDENDS.descr:
Under the [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] effect, if you choose the original card, gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color];
if you choose the linked card, draw {Cards:diff()} cards and reduce its cost by 1 this play.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BEFOREFORGIVEN.title: Before Being Forgiven
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLASSHUG.title: A Hug Through Glass
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLASSHUG.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color].
If this card is burned by [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color], it returns to your hand at [color=#ff0000]the start of next turn[/color] with its cost set to 0, and you gain [color=#ff0000]Block[/color] equal to this card's [color=#ff0000]Block[/color] value.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.title: Don't Take Me Home

Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color].
Choose 1 card in hand to gain [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] and [b]Retain[/b].
If it is still in your hand at [color=#ff0000]end of turn[/color], burn it to gain {Energy:energyIcons()} [color=#ff0000]next turn[/color] and draw {Cards:diff()} [color=#ff0000]cards[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTBRINGMEHOME.select: Choose 1 card in hand to gain [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] and [b]Retain[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WARMTHSHOULDNOTSTAY.de:
Whenever you play a card with [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color],
1 random card without [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] gains [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BURNEDECHO.title: Cut Off the Echo
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FIFTHSELFPROOF.title: The Fifth Self-Proof
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FIFTHSELFPROOF.descrip:
Deal 1 [color=#ff0000]damage[/color] a number of times equal to this card's count.
For every {IfUpgraded:show:6|5} [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] choices completed, this card gains {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} count.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_YALISALINDEATH.title: 「You shall burn as fuel to warm your fellows; when the last ember fades, none shall remember the flame」
ManosabaLin.YalisalinDeath.hovertip.desc:

Play [color=#cccccc]Death[/color],
Give random cards equal to half your number of [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] cards to every teammate, granting them [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color]

Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color].
Consume the earliest {Consume:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] given to the target this turn; that consume's effect is doubled.

Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color] {Hits:diff()} times.
If the [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] actually consumed by this card in two consecutive plays is of different colors, the latter play resolves 1 extra time.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_UNUSEDCONCLUSION.descr:
Give ALL enemies 2 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].
The first time each turn you trigger a [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] chain consume, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 1 [color=#ff0000]card[/color].

Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color],
consume 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASHINPAGES.title: Ash Caught in the Pages
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASHINPAGES.description:
Give ALL enemies {Fire:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].
If there are fewer than 2 enemies, give {ExtraFire:diff()} more [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].
Lose {Life:diff()} HP, give {Fire:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].
If the target is already full, instead consume {Consume:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] and heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTCOOLDOWN.title: Don't Let It Drop
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DONTCOOLDOWN.descripti: At the start of your turn, give a random enemy {Fire:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GRAZINGCRITICAL.title: Grazing the Critical Edge
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GRAZINGCRITICAL.descri:
Give 2 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
{IfUpgraded:show:Consume 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] then give 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].|If the target becomes full as a result, consume 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].}

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DEADLINEHANDOFF.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color] {Repeats:diff()} times. After each hit, consume 1 Fire Color.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TEMPERATUREPROOF.title: Proof of Temperature Difference
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TEMPERATUREPROOF.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color], give 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color],
gain {Block:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Block[/color].
If the damage consumed a Dark Orange slot, double the Block.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TICKETONWINDOW.title: A Ticket on the Window
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TICKETONWINDOW.descrip:
Your effects that give [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] give 1 more.
The first time you have given 5 Fire Color in a turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SAMEWRONGPROBLEM.title: The Same Wrong Answer
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SAMEWRONGPROBLEM.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color] twice.
If the two consumed [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] slots differ in color, your next Skill card costs 0.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TOMORROWBURN.title: A Burn Saved for Tomorrow
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_TOMORROWBURN.descripti:
Give {Fire:diff()} [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].
Any excess over the gauge immediately triggers the matching consume effects.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THIRTEENTHLISTENER.des:
Whenever you trigger a [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] chain,
give 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color], then consume 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] and draw 1 [color=#ff0000]card[/color].

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_POCKETMATCHBOX.descrip:
Give 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].
If its color differs from the previous slot, deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color].

Consume ALL [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color] on ALL enemies; for each slot consumed, deal {Damage:diff()} [color=#ff0000]damage[/color] to ALL enemies.
If at least 6 slots were consumed, draw {Cards:diff()} [color=#ff0000]cards[/color] and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WEIGHT_OF_PAIN.title: Weight of Pain
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WEIGHT_OF_PAIN.descrip: Whenever [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] burns {IfUpgraded:show:1 card|2 cards}, gain 1 [b]Strength[/b] for the rest of combat.

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASH_AFTERGLOW.title: Ash Afterglow
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ASH_AFTERGLOW.descript: Gain {Block:diff()} [color=#6666cc]Block[/color] for each card burned by [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] this turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SECOND_KINDLING.title: Second Kindling
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SECOND_KINDLING.descri:

give the target 1 [color=#ff0000]Fire Color[/color].

Remove all [color=#CC6666]Familiar Shadow[/color] from combat.
